State and local taxes paid $48,000. MAGI is $45,000 over the $505,000 threshold, so the cap drops by 30% of that ($13,500) to $26,900. Deductible SALT: $26,900 ($21,100 is over the cap). Itemized total $46,900 vs standard deduction $32,200: itemizing is larger.

This is an estimate, not tax advice. Check the IRS instructions or ask a tax professional before you file.
